2 tiles you must take on the way wait in the tray until after the clock: whatever the order, the tray reaches 3.
On the way the tray fills to 3, 3 moves with 3 waiting.
The twins of the tiles on the way are locked until after the clock.

sourceIntents.name: honest clock: real fewest moves 8 + spare 1
tray reaches exactly 3 on the fewest way to the clock
sourceIntents.detail: max 3, moves with 3 waiting 3; forced on every way in time: yes

sourceIntents.name: partners held back at the clock (locked)
sourceIntents.detail: 2 of 2 holders out of reach, each holding the twin of a tile waiting at the clock

sourceIntents.name: at least 0 face-down tiles on the dig
no free cruising: the clock not in the last third, the tray busy in the first half
sourceIntents.detail: clock at move 8 of 76; 2 waiting first at move 2

boards.note: sourceIntents describe the spare1 authored base. The transformed spare2 timer/witness and forced-pressure result are independently recorded; no copied pressure claim.
boards.detail: No hidden planned dig, but the existing objective-route guard still rejects this design.
